n: Multifunction Over-the-Range Microwave Oven with Flush Built-In Design
desc: Free the countertop. This KitchenAid® Multifunction Over-the-Range Microwave Oven combines the versatility of an air fryer, toaster oven, convection oven, microwave and ventilation hood, all in one space-saving appliance designed for flush installation within a standard 12 ¾" cutout.
hl: Comfortably fits a variety of dishes with enough height for a mixing bowl and width for a 9" x 13" casserole dish or multiple items at the same time.
Cooks quickly to boil water, defrost ingredients or warm completed dishes to enjoy again.
Uses triple heating elements and a fan for convection baking at temperatures up to 450°F, eliminating the need for a countertop convection oven.
Replaces a countertop air fryer for all of the crisping with none of the clutter.
Illuminate when in use and fade unobtrusively into the sleek black glass of the oven door when the oven is off.
Uses dual heating elements to bake at temperatures up to 450°F, eliminating the need for a countertop convection or toaster oven.
